name: Supply Chain
description: Not a published list: built so the sweeps reach Ob Superheavy Logistics: Extract. Export. Excel., Midnight Sun's Weyland identity, whose once-per-turn search for a card one credit cheaper than a rezzed card the Corp has just trashed, installed and rezzed free of credits, no other deck can reach. Midnight Sun Stage 8c. Every rez cost from 1 to 5 is stocked twice over, so a trash always has a rung below it: Envelopment trashes itself with its own subroutine (5, finding Stavka or Event Horizon), Regolith Mining License trashes itself when its credits are gone (2, finding Ice Wall or Tithe), Svyatogor Excavator trashes another installed card as the turn begins, Stavka as it is rezzed, Kimberlite Field as it is scored and Azef Protocol to be scored. Weyland and neutral cards only, so no influence. Eternal-legal. Downfall Stage 2: two SDS Drone Deployment for two Send a Message, point for point, a program to steal and a program trashed when scored; two Sandstone for two Kessleroid, a barrier that wears down by a virus counter each encounter; and two Roughneck Repair Squad for two PAD Campaign, six credits for three clicks. Downfall Stage 6: two Reduced Service for two Regolith Mining License, an upgrade bought up to four power counters as it is rezzed, each 2[credit] more to run its server, one gone for every successful run on a central. Regolith Mining License is in other decks. Reprints Stage 2: two Archer for its two Event Horizon, still in Land Grab, and two Border Control for its two Tithe, in many decks. Reprints Stage 3: two Corporate Town for its two Svyatogor Excavator, still in Hostile Bid. Tranche 8 Stage 11a: two Beanstalk Royalties and an Aggressive Negotiation for its three Hedge Fund, economy for economy and a search for the turn it scores; Hedge Fund stays in most Corp decks.
